# jenkins — 2019 high-value CVEs (CVSS>=7, CISA KEV, Exploit-DB, or SSVC exploitation active/poc)

### CVE-2019-10349
- Assigner: jenkins | Published: 2019-07-11 | Updated: 2024-08-04 | Max CVSS: None
- Exploit-DB 47111: Jenkins Dependency Graph View Plugin 0.13 - Persistent Cross-Site Scripting (webapps/java, 2019-07-12, verified=0)

A stored cross site scripting vulnerability in Jenkins Dependency Graph Viewer Plugin 0.13 and earlier allowed attackers able to configure jobs in Jenkins to inject arbitrary HTML and JavaScript in the plugin-provided web pages in Jenkins.

Affected:
- Jenkins project / Jenkins Dependency Graph Viewer Plugin: affected 0.13 and earlier

References:
- http://www.openwall.com/lists/oss-security/2019/07/11/4 [mailing-list,x_refsource_MLIST]
- http://packetstormsecurity.com/files/153610/Jenkins-Dependency-Graph-View-0.13-Cross-Site-Scripting.html [x_refsource_MISC]
- http://www.securityfocus.com/bid/109156 [vdb-entry,x_refsource_BID]
- https://jenkins.io/security/advisory/2019-07-11/#SECURITY-1177 [x_refsource_CONFIRM]

### CVE-2019-1003000
- Assigner: jenkins | Published: 2019-01-22 | Updated: 2024-08-05 | Max CVSS: None
- Exploit-DB 46572: Jenkins 2.137 and Pipeline Groovy Plugin 2.61 - ACL Bypass and Metaprogramming Remote Code Execution (Metasploit) (remote/java, 2019-03-19, verified=1)

- Exploit-DB 46427: Jenkins Plugin Script Security < 1.50/Declarative < 1.3.4.1/Groovy < 2.61.1 - Remote Code Execution (PoC) (webapps/java, 2019-02-19, verified=1)

A sandbox bypass vulnerability exists in Script Security Plugin 1.49 and earlier in src/main/java/org/jenkinsci/plugins/scriptsecurity/sandbox/groovy/GroovySandbox.java that allows attackers with the ability to provide sandboxed scripts to execute arbitrary code on the Jenkins master JVM.

Affected:

### CVE-2019-1003001
- Assigner: jenkins | Published: 2019-01-22 | Updated: 2024-08-05 | Max CVSS: None
- Exploit-DB 46572: Jenkins 2.137 and Pipeline Groovy Plugin 2.61 - ACL Bypass and Metaprogramming Remote Code Execution (Metasploit) (remote/java, 2019-03-19, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 46572: Jenkins 2.137 and Pipeline Groovy Plugin 2.61 - ACL Bypass and Metaprogramming Remote Code Execution (Metasploit) (remote/java, 2019-03-19, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 46427: Jenkins Plugin Script Security < 1.50/Declarative < 1.3.4.1/Groovy < 2.61.1 - Remote Code Execution (PoC) (webapps/java, 2019-02-19, verified=1)

A sandbox bypass vulnerability exists in Pipeline: Groovy Plugin 2.61 and earlier in src/main/java/org/jenkinsci/plugins/workflow/cps/CpsFlowDefinition.java, src/main/java/org/jenkinsci/plugins/workflow/cps/CpsGroovyShellFactory.java that allows attackers with Overall/Read permission to provide a pipeline script to an HTTP endpoint that can result in arbitrary code execution on the Jenkins master JVM.

Affected:
- Jenkins project / Pipeline: Groovy Plugin: affected 2.61 and earlier
